description: Latest token launches that just published a profile (website, socials). Useful to spot fresh launches early; pair it with token-audit before buying. 0.005 USDC per call via x402.

chain.description: Optional chain filter, e.g. solana, base

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.
